title: Action history
irreversibleTitle: Irreversible — not on the undo stack
selectLayerHint: Select a layer to view its action history (style / visibility / reorder)
noLayerOps: No layer-attributed commands for this layer on the current undo/redo stacks
layerNote: Note: only undo/redo-stack commands with layer attribution appear here (style / visibility / reorder); irreversible deletes remain on the timeline journal only.
alreadyLatest: Already at the latest state — nothing to roll back

frameProduct.emptyHint: Ask the agent to juxtapose an indicator across years, or call frame_product_bind.
frameProduct.noSharedExpression: Independent legends per frame (no shared ramp)
frameProduct.identityNote: Frame identity = frame_id (stable); list order is display order only.

printLayout.openWorkbench: Open print layout workbench (mm / fonts / atlas)
printLayout.title: Print layout authoring
printLayout.subtitle: Millimetre paper authoring: components, typography, legend columns, templates and atlas order. One committed decision for preview and PDF/SVG/PNG.
printLayout.pageBudgetExceeded: Page count exceeds the existing atlas budget; split the batch.
printLayout.previewHint: Zoom changes display only, never the stored millimetre coordinates.
printLayout.resetDone: Only print-layout page overrides were cleared

replayFailedUndo: Couldn't undo: the server rejected the replay
replayFailedRedo: Couldn't redo: the server rejected the replay
persistOversize: Workbench organization state is too large, so autosave is paused (groups and locks may be lost on refresh). Reduce the number of groups or grouped layers.
persistConflict: Organization state conflicted with someone else's edit. The latest server state is shown; your last change was not applied. Try again.
wfErrCompareSame: Choose a different run to compare
wfErrTimeout: The request timed out. The run list was refreshed (the backend may have created a new run).

recovery.cmpFingerprintDetail: The backend reports the two run fingerprints differ
recovery.replayExactDetail: Uses that run's frozen revision, graph snapshot, and input bindings. Dataset fingerprints are collected again from current data; whether it reproduces must be judged from the run fingerprint, not from this outcome.
recovery.replayLatestDetail: Uses the workflow's current revision and that run's input bindings. The graph may differ from the original run.
